templates.name: Unextended (the original base)
templates.description: Short base (~1:15): Intro, Chorus, DunDunDenDen, Chorus, Madness, final Chorus. No Epicness — the classic short structure.

templates.name: Extended (2:08)
templates.description: The 2:08 extended base's layout: 3 intro hits, short first Chorus, DunDunDenDen, an Epicness after the Chorus that follows it, Awesomeness 1 (the last pattern before the Madness), the Madness, a 12-bar Epicness after the next Chorus and Awesomeness 2 opening the final Chorus.

templates.name: Semi-Extended
templates.description: Medium length with an Epicness and Awesomeness 1, hard pitching (octave/chord/arp layers) and hard FX polishing (heavy OTT, pumping, stutter gates).

templates.name: Extended in minor
templates.description: Extended structure with the wiki's minor variants: Metro/Minor intro, minor chords, 0*,3* minor arps and the minor Awesomeness patterns.

templates.name: 2010 style (Unextended, sampler pitches)
templates.description: Old-school unextended remix: sampler (chipmunk) pitching, no OTT, light polish.

templates.name: Hyper / Vertex (160 BPM)
templates.description: Faster (160 BPM) semi-extended structure with the Hyper/Vertex execution pattern, hard pitching and hard FX.

templates.name: Fast base (150 BPM)
templates.description: The extended-type layout at 150 BPM.

templates.name: High-speed base (170 BPM)
templates.description: A short layout with an Epicness at 170 BPM, hard pitches and FX.

templates.name: Nemesis / Nemesis X

Extended-type layout with an Execution after the DunDunDenDen; 140 BPM unless your base file says otherwise.
